turns.message: What is your return policy? How long do I have to send something back?
turns.stdout:
Here's how returns work at Loom & Linen:

- You can get a refund within 30 days of the delivery date. Day 30 counts and day 31 doesn't. The 30 days start on delivery, not on the order date.
- Refunds go back to your original payment method.
- Each item line can be refunded once, for all its units. Other items in the same order stay eligible.
- If an order hasn't been delivered yet, it can't be refunded. If it's still processing, it can be cancelled instead.
- Sale items are exchange-only. The exception is a defective sale item, which can be refunded once a human agent has verified the defect.

If you'd like to return something, tell me the order and item and I'll check it for you.
